Iran International (English) — confirmed published 1 October 2026, 19:40 BST. Headline: "US targets Iran auto, rail and metals sectors in new sanctions blitz"

Announcing agency: US Treasury Department.

Designated: six Iranian automotive companies (Iran Khodro Company, SAIPA, Iran Khodro Diesel, Pars Khodro, Zamyad, Niroo Motor Shiraz); two rail companies (Islamic Republic of Iran Railway Company, Raja Passenger Trains Company); Heavy Equipment Production Company (HEPCO) and its China-based subsidiary; multiple foreign companies based in Indonesia, the UAE, Turkey and Hong Kong; and two individuals, Ramin Keshvardoust and Mehnoosh Poursaraf Hamedani, plus companies tied to their steel and financial network.

QUOTE (Scott Bessent, US Treasury Secretary): "The Iranian regime's ability to fund its war machine and inflict terror on the world has been severely diminished thanks to Operation Economic Outcast."

QUOTE (Scott Bessent, US Treasury Secretary): "Today's action directly targets Iran's enablers and lays the groundwork for the United States and our partners to drain the regime's revenue once and for all."

Treasury said the targeted sectors provide major revenue sources and logistical capacity while being intertwined with IRGC patronage and sanctions-evasion networks.
